notes.title: Mages Defense Live
notes.content: Mages defense is a third-person strategic adventure game set in a fantasy world with tower defense elements whose main goal is to defend the crystal from waves of enemies by setting deadly traps in their path and using the power of the mages to stop them. defend more than 30 kingdoms from these creatures like evil mages, dragons, orcs, witches, ghosts, wizards, trolls, pirates, skeletons, zombies, vampires, and much more. All of them aim to destroy everyone and conquer the world.
